subject: Intro call: Redwood demo — coordinating AE/SE + IT security
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@federatedbank.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro call: Redwood demo — coordinating AE/SE + IT security

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for signing up and for the interest in Redwood. I saw your trial sign-up and wanted to coordinate a short 45-minute intro demo so Logan (AE) and Hiro (SE) can walk through how Redwood would map to Federated Bank’s latency and private deployment needs.

We recommend including a member from IT/security so we can answer the typical compliance questions up front. Below are a few windows (I included ET/your local zone):
- Tue 17 Mar — 10:00–10:45 ET (07:00–07:45 PT)
- Tue 17 Mar — 14:00–14:45 ET (11:00–11:45 PT)
- Wed 18 Mar — 09:00–09:45 ET (06:00–06:45 PT)

If none of those work, tell me the best 1-hour block and I’ll loop everyone in. I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock time.

Agenda (short):
- 10 minutes: quick discovery + priorities (data residency, SLA targets)
- 25 minutes: demo (Hosted + Dedicated + Private options + security controls)
- 10 minutes: next steps / questions for procurement/security

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
(Attachment: redwood_demo_agenda.pdf)

---
From: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@federatedbank.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@federatedbank.com>, Security Team <security-team@federatedbank.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro call: Redwood demo — coordinating AE/SE + IT security

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks — appreciate this. Could you include someone from our security team on the call? I’ve CC’d our security alias and Tom (who is our product owner for the POC). Security has limited availability this week; they asked for options on Tue/Thu mornings ET. If you can do Tue 10am ET that would be ideal.

Also — do you have a short compliance checklist we can review with them? If so please attach.

Best,
Sophie
Senior PM, Federated Bank

---
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@federatedbank.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@federatedbank.com>, Security Team <security-team@federatedbank.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Intro call: Redwood demo — coordinating AE/SE + IT security

Looping you both in — Sophie from Federated asked for security on the call and prefers Tue 17 Mar at 10am ET. Can you confirm availability? I’ll hold 10–11 ET tentatively until you confirm. Also Sophie asked for a compliance checklist — attaching our short checklist and the demo agenda.

Thanks —
Jasmine
(Attachments: redwood_compliance_checklist.pdf, redwood_demo_agenda.pdf)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@federatedbank.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@federatedbank.com>, Security Team <security-team@federatedbank.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro call: Redwood demo — coordinating AE/SE + IT security

All good from my side for Tue 17 Mar, but I have a Salesforce briefing 10:30–11:30 PT (same as 13:30–14:30 ET) that could conflict with the tail end. If we make this 45 minutes and stick strictly to the agenda I can do 10:00–10:45 ET. Laura, any objections to me leading the discovery + picking up commercial questions?

Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@federatedbank.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>, Security Team <security-team@federatedbank.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@federatedbank.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro call: Redwood demo — coordinating AE/SE + IT security

Hi team —

Security confirmed: Tue 17 Mar 10:00–11:00 ET works but they prefer a hard stop at 11:00. They’d also like a short pre-read (1–2 pages) covering data flows and retention. Can Hiro include a one-slide architecture summary in the deck?

If 10:00–10:45 ET is tight, we can do 10:00–11:00 ET but will need to prioritize security questions at the end.

Thanks,
Sophie

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@federatedbank.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Security Team <security-team@federatedbank.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@federatedbank.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 18:45:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro call: Redwood demo — coordinating AE/SE + IT security

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the heads up. I can prepare a one-slide architecture/data-flow summary and attach a 1-page data retention note. Tue 10:00 ET is 23:00 JST for me; I can join but would prefer the 10:00–10:45 ET slot if we need to be concise. If Federated wants a full 60 minutes I can still make it work but would need to confirm with my manager for the late window.

I’ll prepare the pre-read and attach it to the invite. 

Regards,
Hiro Tanaka
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_dataflow_onepager.pdf)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro call: Redwood demo — coordinating AE/SE + IT security

Great — thanks everyone. Final plan: Tue 17 Mar 10:00–10:45 ET (07:00–07:45 PT). I’ll send a 45-minute calendar invite and include the following attachments: redwood_demo_agenda.pdf, redwood_dataflow_onepager.pdf, and a short compliance checklist. We’ll flag security items at the top of the deck and hold an extra 15 minutes after the demo if anyone wants to continue (subject to Hiro’s availability).

Invite going out now.

Best,
Jasmine
SDR, Redwood Inference
(Attachments: redwood_demo_invite.ics, redwood_demo_agenda.pdf, redwood_dataflow_onepager.pdf)
